messages.subject: Getting started with mirtCAT
parts:
Hi, thank for putting so much time and effort into a great resource. 

I'm trying to run through the vignettes to help me learn the package but I am having difficulties in running these examples in the Shiny GUI. Am I correct in thinking that each vignette contains code for the server.R and ui.R elements of a Shiny app?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Getting started with mirtCAT
parts:
Hi Chris,

I'm not sure what you mean. The package is simply a wrapper to the shiny interface, so you shouldn't really need to know about the server or ui elements. See the wiki for some examples of how to use the package: https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/wiki

Phil
